title: Cuban Culinary Culture
summary: Cuban: citrus and garlic, rice, olive oil.
origins: Cuban cuisine reflects latin geography, trade routes, and home cooking traditions passed through generations.
history: Fresh lime, chili heat, and masa or rice — brightness against rich proteins.
teaching: Char chilies and tomatoes, bloom cumin in fat, finish with cilantro and lime never cooked long.
Dried chilies, cumin, corn products, and fresh lime are non-negotiable.
Signature pairing: citrus and garlic + rice + olive oil.
